row.notes: mov r14,[rbx+8] in FeTile_Get_ListFirstEntrantId: the scan starts here. rbx = the first slot of the entrant-list slot array with a record (or the array start/end when the array is empty), rax = the container [item+0x1c8] (its +0x568 is the array end), rdi = the label chars, rsi = out. Only branches into the start of the instruction; no branch lands inside the patch window.

verify.notes: V8625 own disasm: 141738f1f is mov r14,[rbx+8] (4 bytes) then a nop; inbound branches to 141738f1f are exactly the je/je/jne at ef7/f00/f07 (to the instruction start); nothing targets f20..f23, so the 5-byte window is clean. At that point rbx=first non-null-record slot, or 0 (je ef7) or ==end (je f00) for an empty array; rax=[item+0x1c8] untouched since 141738ed4 so [rax+0x568]=end; rdi=label chars (cmovne at ee9); rsi=out. Guard reads those exactly.
